rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: not_declared, not_declared, failed, not_declared, not_declared. Declared run-command probes: succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded. Run 3 declared build fails; the other runs declare no build command, and all five run probes succeed. The difference concerns the delivered build contract, not runtime capability.
limitation: Undeclared build commands are not counted as successful builds. HTTP listening establishes startup only, not feature fulfillment.
